references.title: A320 Aircraft Characteristics, Airport and Maintenance Planning, Jul 01/26
references.author: Airbus
references.license: Public manufacturer document; local study only, no diagram pixels redistributed
references.scope: Figures 2-2-0-991-009-A01 sheets 1 and 2, 2-3-0-991-032-A01 ground clearances. Outlines traced from a high-zoom raster of the page. Figure 4-4-0-991-001: pilot eye 2.41 m aft of the nose tip, 0.53 m off the centerline, 4.56 m high; 20 degrees down, 30 up.

references.title: Airbus A320neo landing, crop
references.author: Don-vip, derivative work Lämpe
references.license: CC BY-SA 4.0; reference only, no pixels embedded
references.scope: Oblique front view: windshield panes, nacelle size and throat, main gear. Manufacturer livery ignored.

calibration: 16.1 px/m at 2x page render on both axes; length, height, wheelbase and body depth agree within a pixel.

comparisons: Traced tables regenerated into side, top and front renders and inspected; no drawing overlay image was made for this type.
Render inspected beside the oblique photograph. No matched-camera overlay was made.
corrections: Width 3.95 m taken from the annotated bar; the drawn barrel measures 3.85 m.
Keel 1.79 m follows fuselage point F1 (1.72 to 1.82 m): the A320 stands higher than the 737, so the keel rose from the generic 1.49 m rather than falling.
Rectangular nacelle boxes replaced with round LEAP pods 2.78 m tall, 0.46 m clear of the ground (N1 0.46 to 0.56 m).
Seated eye moved from u 3.25 to the published 2.41 and to h 2.80 (4.57 m high). The traced sill then gives the published view without touching it.
First pillar: on the elliptical section its side-view upper end landed near the centerline, across the forward view. Its upper end now stops at the top edge outboard of the pilot (u 1.84 to 2.30).

Kit changes: glass clear from the seat and tinted from outside, as on the Bendy airliner. The thick glareshield slab and its large FLIGHT GUIDANCE lettering are replaced by a thin sloped hood with a rolled lip over a slim mode control strip. The panel, floor and overhead take their reach from the nose skin, and a dark coaming lines the inside of the nose.
Published eye stations for four kit types sit 0.8 m ahead of where the kit had put them, and the same bias was removed here.

limitations: Modelled height sits inside the tabulated 11.83 to 12.08 m, above the 11.76 m general figure, because of the stance and table used.
LEAP fan-nozzle chevrons, flap-track detail and gear doors are omitted or simplified.
Exterior only: shared interior, refitted but not compared with an A320 flight deck.

The first pillar's upper end no longer matches the side view, because the kit's elliptical nose cannot carry the real flat pane. Upward view at the pilot's line is about +37 against the published +30.
Sanity pass only: seating, glass and visibility. The panel, hood and pedestal remain the shared kit interior fitted to the nose, not compared with this type's real flight deck.
